1. **P1: Browser-test target cannot compile.** [BUILD.gn:89](/home/timpan4/.t3/worktrees/helium-arcified/feat-non-ai-release-production/arcified/native/production/update-windows/result/chrome/browser/ui/webui/help/BUILD.gn:89) omits `defines = [ "HAS_OUT_OF_PROC_TEST_RUNNER" ]`. Add the define to `arcified_windows_browser_tests`; otherwise the registered Windows browser-test build fails.

Found two blocking issues.

1. **[P1] Browser-test fixture cannot compile.** [arcified_update_linux_browsertest.cc:92](/home/timpan4/.t3/worktrees/helium-arcified/feat-non-ai-release-production/arcified/native/production/update-linux/result/chrome/browser/ui/webui/settings/arcified_update_linux_browsertest.cc:92) default-constructs `InstalledVersionPoller::ScopedDisableForTesting`. Its constructor is private in the pinned source. Initialize it through `InstalledVersionPoller::MakeScopedDisableForTesting()`. Otherwise, the registered Linux `browser_tests` target fails compilation.

2. **[P1] New GRIT part lacks required dependency registration.** [generated_resources.grd:272](/home/timpan4/.t3/worktrees/helium-arcified/feat-non-ai-release-production/arcified/native/production/update-linux/result/chrome/app/generated_resources.grd:272) adds `arcified_update_linux_strings.grdp`, but the packet omits the corresponding update to `chrome/app/generated_resources.grd.gritdeps`. The existing build requires the dependency check, and [grit_info.py:174](/home/timpan4/.t3/builds/arcified-linux-155-native-v1/src/tools/grit/grit_info.py:174) rejects mismatches. Integrating this packet alone therefore fails resource generation.

1. **Blocking, P1: browser test uses an incompatible API.** [version_updater_arcified_mac_browsertest.cc:24](/home/timpan4/.t3/worktrees/helium-arcified/feat-non-ai-release-production/arcified/native/production/update-macos/result/chrome/browser/ui/webui/help/version_updater_arcified_mac_browsertest.cc:24) calls `browser()->profile()`, repeated in the retention assertion. In the pinned source, `InProcessBrowserTest::browser()` returns `BrowserWindowInterface*`, which has `GetProfile()` and no `profile()`. The registered macOS browser-test target will fail compilation. Replace both calls with `browser()->GetProfile()` or the fixture's `GetProfile()`, then refresh the patch and hashes.
